games.name: Producer Race
games.line: Pick the producer that wins each 6-hour race, four a day. A 2nd or 3rd place finish scores a Show.

board.unranked: To play on the Staked board, stake at least 1 VHP in the Producer Race.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (from Week 1, the week of Mon 9 Nov).

games.name: Daily Questions
games.line: Answer quick questions about block producers, Monday to Saturday. Stake VHP to share the weekly rewards.

games.name: Who Signs Block X
games.line: Pick the producer for the next 12 milestone blocks, about 2 hours apart.

board.unranked: The Staked board is for wallets with at least 1 VHP staked in Block X that week.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (picks on 3 or more days, at least 1 point).

games.name: Survivor
games.line: One producer a day, two lives, four-week seasons. Last one standing wins.

games.name: Fantasy Producers
games.line: Draft 5 producers under a salary cap, with a captain who scores double.

games.name: Block Golf
games.line: Nine holes a day: guess how many blocks until a producer signs its next one.
